title: Full-Time Tenure Track Faculty: Finance (Associate Professor)
description:
Overview

The School of Business at Quinnipiac University invites dynamic,
innovative, and student-focused educators to join our Finance
Department as a tenure-track Associate Professor of Finance
beginning in Fall 2027.

The School of Business seeks a faculty member who can contribute
not only through excellence in teaching and scholarship, but also
through leadership in program development, faculty collaboration,
industry engagement, and strategic initiatives.

The successful candidate will help shape the future direction of
finance education, contribute to strategic initiatives across the
School of Business, and play a meaningful role in the continued
growth of the department's nationally recognized finance and
financial technology programs.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate a record of academic
accomplishment and evidence of leadership potential in areas such
as curriculum development, program administration, faculty
governance, industry engagement, junior faculty mentoring, student
mentoring, and strategic initiatives.

We seek candidates whose research and teaching interests contribute
to the evolving intersection of Finance, Financial Analytics,
Artificial Intelligence, FinTech, Healthcare Finance,
Biotechnology, and data-driven decision making. We welcome
candidates employing both traditional and emerging approaches to
important questions in finance. Opportunities exist for
interdisciplinary collaboration with faculty across the School of
Business and the broader university in areas related to analytics,
artificial intelligence, technology, law, healthcare, and
innovation.

Teaching responsibilities may include undergraduate and graduate
courses in finance, including Investments, Portfolio Management,
Corporate Finance, Financial Markets and Institutions, Financial
Analytics, FinTech, Decentralized Finance (DeFi), and related
areas. The successful candidate will have opportunities to
contribute to the continued development of innovative programs in
Financial Technology, Financial Analytics, Healthcare Finance, and
AI applications in finance.

Candidates should demonstrate an established and sustained record
of scholarly achievement, with evidence of continuing contributions
to high-quality finance research. The department is particularly
interested in candidates whose scholarship explores how emerging
technologies are reshaping financial markets, institutions, firms,
and investors. Relevant areas may include, but are not limited
to:

Artificial intelligence and machine learning in financial
decision-making
Asset pricing
Investment analysis
Portfolio management
Financial analytics and predictive modeling
Alternative data and computational finance
FinTech innovation
Digital assets, blockchain, and decentralized finance
Generative AI and large language models in finance
AI governance, regulation, and the ethical implications for
financial markets

About the School

The Finance Department offers a collaborative and intellectually
vibrant environment where faculty are committed to excellence in
both teaching and scholarship. As the largest major in the School
of Business, the department offers both a B.S. in Finance and a
B.S. in Financial Technology. Faculty also contribute to graduate
education through the MBA and Professional MBA programs.

What truly distinguishes the Quinnipiac finance experience is the
opportunity to connect classroom learning with industry engagement
at the highest levels. The department oversees the Quinnipiac
University Global Asset Management Education Forum (GAME), the
largest student-run finance conference in the world. Each year,
GAME brings together nearly 1,500 students and faculty from more
than 125 global colleges and universities, creating unparalleled
opportunities for faculty and students to engage with and learn
from renowned leaders across the financial industry.

Faculty and students also benefit from access to our
state-of-the-art Financial Technology Center, which supports
experiential learning and serves as the home of the department’s
$6.0 million student-managed investment fund. Together, these
programs create a rich environment where faculty can mentor
students, pursue innovative ideas, and connect academic learning
with professional practice.

Faculty maintain active research agendas and publish in leading
journals in finance, economics, and related disciplines.

Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

Teach undergraduate and graduate finance courses, both online
and on ground
Maintain an active research agenda leading to publication in
high-quality journals
Advise and mentor students
Actively participate in department, school, and university
service
Collaborate with faculty colleagues in teaching and
research
Support experiential learning and industry engagement
initiatives
Contribute to curriculum development and program
innovation
Assist with recruitment, retention, and co-curricular
activities
Help build external partnerships that support teaching,
research, and student success
Support the University’s Lifelong Learning Initiatives

Additional Responsibilities May Include

Providing leadership in curriculum development and assessment
initiatives
Supporting strategic planning efforts within the department and
School of Business
Mentoring junior faculty and contributing to faculty
development initiatives
Assisting with accreditation, program review, and assessment
activities
Helping strengthen relationships with industry partners,
alumni, and professional organizations

Education Requirements

Ph.D. in Finance, FinTech, Economics, or a closely related
field from an accredited Business School or University

Qualifications

Primary Qualifications

Ph.D. in Finance, Economics, or closely related field from an
accredited institution
Demonstrated excellence in teaching
Ability to engage students in active and experiential
learning
Scholarly activity sufficient to meet Quinnipiac University
School of Business AACSB Scholarly Academic standards
Demonstrated ability to contribute positively to a
collaborative academic environment
Demonstrated experience leading academic, professional, or
strategic initiatives
Experience with curriculum development, assessment, or program
innovation
Experience building partnerships with industry, alumni, or
external stakeholders
Experience mentoring junior faculty and students
Evidence of successful collaboration across departments or
disciplines
Interest in future leadership opportunities within the
department, school, or university

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using programming, statistical, or analytical tools
such as Python, R, SQL, machine learning frameworks, or related
technologies
Prior experience teaching experience in Financial Analytics,
FinTech, or AI-related finance courses
Evidence of interdisciplinary collaboration involving
technology and finance

Special Instructions to Applicants

Applications must be submitted electronically and include a resume,
a cover letter detailing how your experience aligns with the
position requirements, demonstrated commitment to intentional
leadership that values individuals of all backgrounds and
experiences, and contact information for three references. In
addition, please submit as part of your application:

• A curriculum vitae (please include evidence of teaching
effectiveness, relevant industry experience, student mentoring,
scholarly activity, and service)

• A description of previous teaching experience including course
evaluations

• Research manuscript, paper, or other evidence of scholarly
engagement

• Evidence of leadership roles

The anticipated salary range for this position is
$180,000–$190,000. At the time of offer, the final salary will be
determined based on the selected candidate’s qualifications,
including relevant education, experience, skills, and competencies,
as well as internal equity and market considerations. Quinnipiac
University offers eligible full-time faculty and staff a
comprehensive benefits package that may include health insurance,
life insurance, paid time off, education benefits, and retirement
benefits.

Advertised: August 25, 2026 Eastern Daylight Time
